title: Price Setting and Volatility: Evidence from Oil Price Volatility Shocks
title_zh: 价格设定与波动性：来自油价波动冲击的证据
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Do changes in aggregate volatility alter the impulse response of output to monetary policy? I use plausibly exogenous oil price volatility shocks and exploit heterogene- ity in oil usage across industries to show that PPI item level price changes become less frequent and more disperse when volatility is high. This implies aggregate price flexibility does not increase when aggregate volatility is high. I construct a state- dependent pricing model with random menu costs to interpret the findings. Match- ing the new empirical facts, the model shows that increases in aggregate volatility do not substantially reduce monetary policy effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 总体波动性的变化是否会改变产出对货币政策的脉冲响应？本文利用外生性较强的石油价格波动冲击，并借助各行业石油使用量的异质性，发现当波动性较高时，生产者价格指数（PPI）分项价格变动频率降低且离散程度增大。这意味着总体波动性较高时，总体价格灵活性并未提升。为解释这一发现，本文构建了一个包含随机菜单成本的状态依存定价模型。在匹配新经验事实的基础上，该模型表明，总体波动性的上升并不会显著削弱货币政策的有效性。

authors: 梅建明, 张吉喆, 吴煜卓, 邵鹏程

abstract: 作为一项党中央部署的关键任务,农业转移人口市民化经过十余年的探索已取得了一定成就,但也面临诸多现实挑战,许多制度顽疾依然未得到有效解决。这需要进一步梳理农业转移人口市民化政策,分析制约推进这一任务的关键桎梏,并设计更为完善的长效机制。对此,首先,本文构建基于政策“目标—实践”的农业转移人口市民化分析框架,概括推进农业转移人口市民化过程中存在的“政策困局”。其次,本文围绕客观环境限制、制度设计与执行...

title: Beyond Mean Exposure: How Exposure Variance Shapes Air Pollution Mortality Risk
title_zh: 超越均值暴露：暴露方差如何塑造空气污染死亡风险
authors: Bissan Ghaddar, Kimberly Singer Babiarz, Hongbin Li, Lingsheng Meng, Lynn Hildemann, Han Hong, Alvise Scarabosio, Meili Wang, Aprajit Mahajan, Peng Yin, Maigeng Zhou, Grant Miller
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Ambient air pollution contributes substantially to premature mortality globally, and the effectiveness of policies addressing it depends critically on the shape of the dose-response relationship, which remains poorly understood. Linking hourly air pollution data with daily vital statistics from 251 Chinese cities over four years, we show this relationship depends not only on the mean, but also on the variance of within-period exposure. At a 7-day mean of 150 μg/m³, predicted mortality varies more across observed hourly PM2.5 distributions than across mean exposure differences of 100 μg/m³. The sign of this variance effect also depends on the mean: at low mean concentrations (a convex region), higher variance is associated with modestly higher mortality. At higher concentrations (a concave region), greater variance is associated with lower mortality – implying constant exposure is more harmful than fluctuating exposure for a given mean. These findings reveal important relationships masked using temporally aggregated air pollution data.
abstract_zh: 环境空气污染是全球过早死亡的重要诱因，而相关政策的有效性关键取决于剂量-反应关系的形态，但目前对此认知仍不充分。通过将中国251个城市四年的逐时空气污染数据与每日生命统计数据相关联，我们发现这种关系不仅取决于时段内暴露的均值，还取决于其方差。在7天均值为150 μg/m³的条件下，基于观测到的逐时PM2.5分布差异所预测的死亡率变化，甚至超过均值暴露差异达100 μg/m³时的影响。这种方差效应的方向也取决于均值：在低均值浓度（凸性区域）下，较高方差与死亡率适度上升相关；而在高浓度（凹性区域）下，较大方差则与死亡率下降相关——这意味着在给定均值条件下，持续暴露比波动暴露更具危害性。这些发现揭示了使用时间聚合空气污染数据时被掩盖的重要关联关系。

title: GLP-1 Therapy and the Reshaping of Socioeconomic Gradients in Health
title_zh: GLP-1疗法与健康社会经济梯度的重塑
authors: Montano-Campos, J. Felipe, Tysinger, Bryan, Goldman, Dana, Lakdawalla, Darius, Tysinger, Bryan Clark, Goldman, Dana P., Lakdawalla, Darius Noshir
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: GLP-1 therapies for obesity promise substantial health improvements, but little is known about how their benefits vary across socioeconomic and demographic groups. Using a nationally representative microsimulation model of US adults and Shapely-value decomposition, we estimate the lifetime health and economic benefits of GLP-1 treatment and examine how those gains vary across individuals. The largest differences emerge across education. Individuals with less than a high school education experience experience roughly 14% higher gains in lifetime net social value, 16-17% larger improvements in discounted generalized risk- and severity-adjusted life-years (GRASA-QALYs), and 20% greater increases in life expectancy relative to the cohort mean, whereas individuals with college degrees experience gains 15-27% below the mean across these outcomes. Black and Hispanic individuals also tend to experience larger improvements in health outcomes and social value than White individuals, including larger gains in GRASA-QALYs and life expectancy and larger reductions in diabetes risk and duration. Females likewise experience larger predicted treatment gains than men. These patterns are consistent with the idea that the largest gains arise among populations facing greater socioeconomic constraints in sustaining behavioral weight control. GLP-1 innovation may therefore mitigate inequality in obesity-related disease and survival, advancing equity in population health.
abstract_zh: GLP-1肥胖疗法有望带来显著的健康改善，但关于其收益在不同社会经济和人口群体间的差异尚知之甚少。利用具有全国代表性的美国成年人微观模拟模型和沙普利值分解方法，我们估算了GLP-1治疗带来的终生健康与经济收益，并考察了这些收益在个体间的差异。最大差异出现在教育水平上：与队列均值相比，高中以下学历人群的终生净社会价值收益高出约14%，贴现后广义风险与严重程度调整生命年（GRASA-QALYs）改善幅度高出16-17%，预期寿命增长高出20%；而拥有大学学历人群在上述指标上的收益则低于均值15-27%。黑人和西班牙裔个体在健康结果和社会价值方面的改善幅度也往往大于白人群体，包括GRASA-QALYs和预期寿命的更大提升，以及糖尿病风险与病程的更大程度降低。女性预测的治疗收益同样高于男性。这些模式与以下观点一致：在维持行为体重控制方面面临更大社会经济约束的人群，其收益最大。因此，GLP-1创新可能缓解肥胖相关疾病与生存方面的不平等，促进人口健康公平。

title: The Economic and Ecological Impact of Soy in Brazil: A Synthetic Control Method Approach
title_zh: 巴西大豆的经济与生态影响：基于合成控制法的研究
authors: Stefano Ghinoi, Simone Piras, Luca Tasciotti, Valdemar João Wesz Junior
abstract: ABSTRACT In recent decades, soy expansion in Brazil has generated significant environmental, social and economic impacts. However, there is no consensus about benefits and drawbacks, calling for a more careful account of the economic and ecological diversity of the territories where this phenomenon has been unfolding. By acknowledging this diversity, we investigate the economic and ecological impacts of soy by applying a synthetic control method to longitudinal data (1990–2019) at state level. We focus on three indicators (GDP, CO 2 emissions and deforestation) and explore how these indicators vary in five states (Goiás, Paraná, Piauí, Rio Grande do Sul, Tocantins). These states differ in terms of underlying conditions and timing of soy expansion but have in common a significant contribution of soy to their GDP. From an environmental perspective, the states where soy consolidated its presence during the period considered (Goiás and Paraná) experienced a general improvement compared to their synthetic counterfactuals, especially in terms of deforestation, while a pioneer state in soy production such as Rio Grande do Sul saw a worsening in environmental indicators, especially right after the 2008 global financial crisis. This is also reflected in the impact of soy on GDP, which has been negative in this state, suggesting that it may have suffered from being a plantation economy, with soy subtracting resources from potentially more beneficial sectors. This geographical and temporal heterogeneity indicates that the economic and environmental impact of soy cannot be reduced to a single dominant trend. The outcome depends on the trade‐offs with other sectors, which is in turn linked to the level of economic development of the state when soy took off.
